persona: Colocation technician moving up to data center engineer
resumeText:
Arjun Nair | Chennai | arjun.nair@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Data Centre Technician, Coromandel Colo Services, Chennai (2021 - present)
- Racked and stacked over 300 Dell and HPE servers across two colocation halls.
- Ran and labelled Cat6 and single-mode fibre cabling between racks and patch panels.
- Replaced failed disks, memory and power supplies and handled RMA returns with vendors.
- Installed Ubuntu and RHEL on new servers and set up iLO and iDRAC access.
- Worked change and incident tickets in the ticketing tool on 24x7 rotational shifts.
- Tested fibre links with an OTDR and a light meter.

SKILLS
Linux, TCP/IP, VLANs, Windows Server

EDUCATION
Diploma in Electronics and Communication, Central Polytechnic College, Chennai, 2021
